title: Open, close, and count
hints: Store one record per session in a dict keyed by session_id. What fields does a session need? Start time, end time (or None while open), and the set of task ids.
A small @dataclass keeps the record readable: `opened_at: int`, `closed_at: int | None = None`, `tasks: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)`.
Write a private `_get(session_id)` helper that raises KeyError for unknown ids, so every public method validates the same way.
Elapsed is `(closed_at if closed_at is not None else self.clock.now()) - opened_at`. Watch out: `closed_at` can legitimately be 0, so test `is not None`, not truthiness.
